description: Move the rover for a fixed time: forward / backward, or turn left / right in place. Turns autopilot off and starts the simulation. Rotation speed is about 2 rad/s (≈115°/s), so turning 90° takes ≈0.8 s. Forward speed is 65 % of max speed (≈61 px/s at the default 55 % power; backward ≈51 px/s). With wait=true (default) it returns the observation after the move finishes. The rover stops on collisions.

seconds.description: Duration, 0.2–10 s (default 2 for forward/backward, 1 for turns)

wait.description: Wait for the move to finish before returning (default true)

name: drive
title: Drive
